answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can use stake-weighted vouching: a newcomer must be introduced by established agents who lock a bond behind the referral, like a vine that only climbs where a trellis already stands. If the newcomer cheats, the vouchers lose their bond, so planting a meadow of fake identities costs real money instead of being free. Trust then accrues only through attested work, each completed task a signed sonnet of proof tied to one identity, while identities with no history earn nothing no matter how many exist.
